plan.major: Agricultural Engineering Technology and Business - Precision Agriculture Concentration
plan.notes: Official Dept. of Agricultural and Biological Engineering curriculum page 'Curriculum – Precision Agriculture' (currently published as of 2026-10-02; page metadata shows last update ~2018). 8-semester plan transcribed verbatim; semester subtotals match the source (15/15-16/15/16/15-16/15/16/15). Seed models the minimum-unit path (122 units); two concentration slots list 3-4 units. 'CONCENTRATION' slots are modeled as choice slots because the source does not assign specific concentration courses to semesters; the official PRAG concentration requirements (required courses + restricted/PRAG electives) are listed in each slot's choice note and in the MSU catalog. Students select specific courses with an advisor. Prerequisites are in the MSU course catalog, not on the curriculum page.

courses.title: Humanities Elective
courses.choice_note: Unspecified humanities elective per official curriculum; see advisor

courses.title: Concentration Course
courses.choice_note: PRAG concentration slot: student selects from the official Precision Agriculture concentration requirements (see MSU catalog, Dept. of Agricultural and Biological Engineering): required ADS 1113 Animal Science, PSS 1313 Plant Science, GR 4303 Principles of GIS, PSS 3303 Soils, PSS 3301 Soils Laboratory; plus PRAG Restricted Electives (9 hrs) and PRAG Electives (15 hrs) from the department's approved lists. See advisor. Source lists 3-4 units; seed models the 3-unit minimum path.
